name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-ace-strategy-pattern
title: Adaptive Card Extension strategy pattern
shortDescription: Avoid complex conditional logic in Adaptive Card Extension quick view actions by using the strategy pattern.
longDescription: This sample exposes organization news in an adaptive card and implements navigation, likes, comments, and sharing news to a Teams channel using isolated quick view actions.
